description: Investigators pursue the suspect fugitive Caesar, maneuvering under the guise of medical students, engaging in verbal sparring to covertly extract information.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Draw the pistol and aim at the person in front

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "A pistol? Do you know how the Blackshirts would view a foreigner having something like this?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "But dead men tell no tales."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You just need to shut up."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "And that's not the case."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Examine his attire

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Put the gun away, prepare to start communicating

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I don't know who this Antonio you speak of is," Caesar says coldly, looking at Bolan.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Is there really a need to keep hiding? I know Antonio Termona isn't at ease with us, so he sent you."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar's pupils suddenly contract into vertical slits. For R'lyeh! The dagger whistles through the air, stabbing straight at Bolan's abdomen.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Prepare to dodge this attack and signal companions to knock him out

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .ra Brawl 40

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player2>'s Brawl 40 prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .ra Dodge

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player3>'s Dodge prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar's dagger grazes Bolan's wool coat, the blade tip scraping against the stone wall with a piercing sound.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Move forward to block his retreat path

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player6 SAN82 HP12/12 DEX80

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: .ra Sword

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player6>'s Sword prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .ra Brawl 40

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player2>'s Brawl 40 prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player6's rapier and Caesar's dagger slide past each other in the air, metal friction sparking sporadic sparks.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player2>'s Spear 50 prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .ra Dodge 40

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player2>'s Dodge 40 prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Johnson's spear tip grazes Caesar's trouser leg. The other's backward step happens to land on scattered library flyers. Caesar stumbles and falls flat on his back, the back of his head hitting the paving stone with a dull thud, then the whole person goes limp and motionless. The dagger slips from his loosened fingers, making a crisp sound on the stone surface.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Seeing he's motionless, take out hemp rope and tie him up

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: So, while this side is fighting fiercely,

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hello, old sir."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The other person suddenly looked up, his empty sleeves sweeping across the table. He opened his mouth, revealing the dark red cavity where his tongue root had been removed, and a bellows-like sucking sound came from his throat.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #takes a step back in fright

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Grausinger suddenly banged his forehead against the table, making a dull thumping sound. The librarian came over at the noise, "What's wrong, sir?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ahem, this old gentleman bumped himself."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The other person stood up, his empty sleeves swaying slightly. He gave player4 a deep look, then turned and quickly walked towards the fire escape.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #tries to talk to the librarian

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The librarian picked up the knocked-askew glasses, "Yes, I do. Mr. Grausinger... sigh, just pretend you never met him. He went mad after the shock, don't provoke him." He wiped his glasses.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?? Why is that, can you tell me in detail?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The librarian spread his hands helplessly, "To be honest, no one really knows. Four years ago, he suddenly became like this." He pointed towards the fire escape, "Comes to read on time every day, but never allows anyone to question him."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "If possible, could you tell me your name? I'll include you in the acknowledgments."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh right, at first he tried to bite a pen to write some crazy things like 'skin brotherhood', 'face-peelers'."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The librarian took half a step back, showing a guarded expression. "The way you say that..." He forced a smile, "Don't tell me you believe those ghost stories about peeling people's faces? Should I help you contact the Sant'Anna Sanatorium's car? They've recently opened a nice... uh... rest area there."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sigh, young man."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The librarian rapidly recited, "The seventh metal box in the shack area west of Molo Wharf," then raised his voice: "Closing time!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But thank you anyway, I thank you on behalf of the FBI."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 pushes open the library's brass door and sees the companions gathered around Caesar who has fallen to the ground. Johnson has tied his hands and feet, and player6's rapier tip lightly presses against his throat.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You came just in time, do you have a way to make this guy pass out?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But you can't just tie someone up and take them away."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Right here? That works too."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "That depends on his own constitution."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Sedatives, that kind of thing?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (I might not have brought any.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered, <player4>'s lucky wish:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 discovers they've been carrying syringe candy as sedatives all along.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, not bad."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then we'll have to try some primitive methods." #gestures for Xiao Tang to wrap the rope around him a few more times.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But I have this."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #drapes the trench coat over this guy, lets Johnson carry him, don't let those measures show, then goes out to hail a taxi.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Alright then"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Return to the hotel

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The doorman pulls open the carved glass door. His motion of taking the key ring carries a sense of unfamiliarity. Welcome back, gentlemen.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Check if the doorman has been replaced

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Carefully observe the doorman's movements

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (player5, make a Spot Hidden check)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .ra spot hidden

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player5>'s Spot Hidden prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 blinks and sees the doorman's facial skin slide off like melting wax, revealing a bloody skull eye socket, but the next second it returns to the ordinary young man's smiling face. What's wrong, sir? The doorman grins at him with the corners of his mouth stretched. (.sc 0/1d4)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Huh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone is watching.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (player4 can also make a Spot Hidden check)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra spot hidden

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response. <player4>'s Spot Hidden prayer:

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Carrying the person, step back to keep distance, check if the left arm belongs to a cultist.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 notices that when the doorman takes player5's coat, a three-centimeter stretch of pale skin is exposed between the cuff and the wrist bone, which should have been completely covered by the uniform. The other party also tiptoes too deliberately when hanging the coat hook, as if stepping on invisible stilts. As for the tattoo, it's not visible, blocked by the uniform.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Waves hand. "We've already eaten outside."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The waiter nods. Very well, sir.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #First return to my own room, check if anyone has touched my things.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Prepare to go back and thoroughly check my things.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The brass key turns smoothly. The furnishings inside the room are completely consistent with when you left.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "This person is probably the one sent by that collector we encountered earlier to keep an eye on us."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Those skinless lunatics"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar struggles with his eyelids amidst the ropes, trembling slightly.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Pat his face. "Really don't remember?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar suddenly raises his head and bumps into player5's fingers. Don't touch me!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What is Rognir?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar clenches his teeth and turns his head away. He closes his eyes and remains silent for a moment, then suddenly forces out a twisted smile: My life... should have been left in the karst cave three years ago. I won't talk.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh my, a tough nut."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's cut off one of his testicles first."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Seems... a bit cruel.."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I don't want to do this kind of surgery that dirties my hands"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #claps hands "I also don't wish to resort to overly cruel methods"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #pulls Xiao Tang, preparing to politely exit

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #honestly goes out

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. Caesar, is it?"
